liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Organ Farmer** (1 review): Organ Farmer appears on the Predator X track due to mislabeling [5]
- **Her and I (Slow Jam II)** (1 review): This section should include all of what is tracked as Organ Farmer [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **Alter Me III**: back after 32 archived shows (1109 days); rare: 9 archived performances [9]

## The recordings

- **kglw2022-10-22.ScheopsMK41.Flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 16 songs; 104 min; rated 4.29/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: Listener describes the audio quality of the tape as incredible; Reviewer calls it one of the highest quality fan recordings yet; Bass is slightly quiet, matching the live venue's acoustic characteristics [2][4][5]

## Around the show

- Crowd formed a huge mosh pit during KGLW, with tracers flying [7]
- Venue had little room, forcing the reviewer to stand relatively far back [7]
- Reviewer describes the venue as a huge metal box with good audio [8]
- Reviewer ranks this recording alongside Berkeley and Bimbo's 365 captures [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2022-10-22.ScheopsMK41.Flac24**: taped by Joe Burns; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: Scheops MK41's > Actives > BabyNBox > Roland r07 > 24/48 [1]. Also: Processed through Audacity, CDWAV, and Foobar2000 before final FLAC output [1]

## Art and photos

- Poster by I Just Read About That...: [King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard (Franklin Music Hall, Philadelphia, PA, October 22, 2022) rescheduled, rescheduled ag](https://ijustreadaboutthat.com/2022/10/24/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-franklin-music-hall-philadelphia-pa-october-22-2022-rescheduled-rescheduled-again/) [10]
